subject: MAP re-phase request: evaluation window shift & consolidated risk log
messages:
From: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@olivehealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Michael Troy <michael.troy@olivehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to shift evaluation window / MAP update

Hi Priyom,

Quick heads up from our side — the security review for the integration is taking longer than expected. Our InfoSec team surfaced two additional items (attached) that they want validated during the eval. Because of that, we need to shift the evaluation window originally planned for Sep 20-24 by one week.

Specifically: can we move the MAP evaluation window to Sep 27 - Oct 1, and update the MAP milestones accordingly? Procurement also asked that any timeline changes be reflected in the SOW so they can start their approval run.

We appreciate Redwood being flexible on this — the integration is still a high priority for Olive, but we cant move forward on Production until the security items are closed. Attached: Olive_QA_requirements.pdf (security checklist).

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Connors
Head of Integrations, Olive Health
attachments: Olive_QA_requirements.pdf
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@olivehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to shift evaluation window / MAP update

Sarah — thanks for the note and for sharing the checklist. Weve reviewed the items and can accommodate a one-week shift.

Action items I propose (RWI side):
- Update MAP milestones to reflect evaluation window Sep 27 - Oct 1 (draft attached).
- Maintain current cutover goal (target production 2026-10-15) but add a 1-week contingency window in the risk log.
- Deliver a consolidated risk log (single doc) by Sep 17 so were aligned before the eval run.
- Assign a technical owner to run the canary and report daily token-level latency/cost snapshots during the eval.

For procurement: Laura, can you prepare a redline of the SOW that highlights the new eval dates and the contingency language Priyom outlined? Neha, please start the risk log template and include a short fallback playbook (reduced throughput canary + temp staging).

Im attaching the draft MAP (RWI_MAP_draft_v3.xlsx) with the proposed milestone shifts and a short notes tab for security validations. If Olive signs off, well publish the MAP and the consolidated risk log and kick off the canary plan.

Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
attachments: RWI_MAP_draft_v3.xlsx
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@olivehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 10:24:00 -0700
Subject: Escalation: Procurement & SOW timing impact (for exec-awareness)

Priyom / Laura — looping procurement given the SOW dependency.

Procurement team, heads up: Olives shift of the evaluation window pushes our cutover slack into the final approval cadence. Thats manageable, but it also means were likely to need a short-term SLA credit if validation extends beyond Oct 8 and prevents us from hitting the Oct 15 production goal. Can procurement flag the internal approval path and expected review lead times so we can align the MAP SLA clauses?

I recommend we add an explicit clause in the SOW around evaluation-window-driven delays and an approval SLA (48-72 hours per milestone sign-off) to avoid ambiguity. Laura, can you apply the Procurement_SOW_template.docx and highlight the clause for their review? Ill draft the consolidated risk log (initial entry below) and circulate for sign-off by Sep 17: 

- Risk ID: R-OLV-002
- Title: Evaluation window slip due to InfoSec validation
- Likelihood: Medium
- Impact: Potential 1-2 week slip to production; possible need for SLA credit if validation extends beyond gated windows
- Mitigation: Temporary canary in staging, prioritized patching lane for security items, daily status cadence during eval run

Neha Kapoor
VP, Customer Success (oncall: cs-oncall@redwoodinference.com)
attachments: Procurement_SOW_template.docx
From: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@olivehealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 08:52:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to shift evaluation window / MAP update

Thanks, Priyom and Neha. Weve scheduled an internal exec review for Tue 16 Sep (afternoon PST). Procurement is looping in legal; they asked for the updated SOW redline and a single consolidated risk log prior to the review.

Quick asks from Olive before the exec review:
1) One consolidated risk log (youre on Sep 17 target)
2) A named technical owner who will be on the daily eval calls to unblock issues (please include cell number)
3) Confirmation that the MAP includes a fallback (reduced-throughput canary) so we can maintain a live review without full traffic

We can confirm the new eval window after the exec review. Appreciate the quick turnaround on the docs.

—Sarah
On Tue, Sep 15, 2026 at 08:52 AM Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@olivehealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks again — Sarah
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@olivehealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to shift evaluation window / MAP update — consolidated deliverables

Sarah / team — following up with the consolidated list and short plan.

Deliverables (RWI -> Olive) by EOD Sep 17:
- Single consolidated risk log (R-OLV master) with mitigation lanes and acceptance criteria (link + attached PDF in follow-up).
- Final MAP with revised eval window (Sep 27 - Oct 1) and fallback canary run included.
- SOW redline prepared by Laura (Procurement_SOW_template applied).
- Named technical owner: Jonas Weber (jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, +1-415-555-0198). Jonas will lead the daily eval calls and own the canary controller.

Fallback playbook summary:
- Canary type: reduced-throughput (25% traffic) for initial 48 hours, then expand if metrics stable.
- Monitoring: token-level latency, tail-p99, and per-route error rates; daily digest to Olive leadership.
- Cutover contingency: if security items persist beyond Oct 8, well execute a staggered roll (beta cohort) and open a credit discussion (per SOW clause).

Neha and Laura — Ill coordinate the doc bundle and send a single ZIP to procurement and legal. Sarah — please confirm after Tue 16 exec review and well lock the MAP.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | priom.das@redwoodinference.com | +1-415-555-0123
attachments: (will attach consolidated_risk_log_R-OLV-002.pdf in follow-up)
